name: AI Model 3.0
author: NakshaTech Software Team
description: AI model 3.0 LiDAR classification as an installable plugin. Classifies the open point cloud, or only the points inside selected fences, into the classes of the applied .ptc file (Ground, low / medium / high vegetation, buildings and, when the .ptc has them, power-line wires and poles). Optionally learns from already classified areas inside the fences: they are kept unchanged and the unfinished points follow their classes and height bands. Results are written straight into the native Vulkan view with undo; a classified copy of the source file is saved to AI3_Classified. The plugin includes its own Python runtime, dependencies, engine and model. Compatible existing runtimes are verified and reused; otherwise offline setup runs automatically after installation; no AI3 installation in the host software is required.
